descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]从[From.GetName]检测到了一些有趣的读数。那颗气态巨行星的大气层中有高剂量的辐射，似乎是由密集的轨道轰炸引起的。至于为什么有人要这么做则是个谜。

就在[Root.GetName]准备离开轨道时，科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]从行星内部检测到了一个微弱的信号。或许是某种通讯信号，但行星的背景辐射太强，很难将信号从背景噪声中分离出来。
descriptions.en:
The [Root.GetName] has picked up some curious readings from [From.GetName]. There are significant pockets of radiation in the gas giant's atmosphere that appear to be the result of intense orbital bombardment. What someone could hope to gain by bombing a gas giant from orbit remains a mystery however.

As the [Root.GetName] was preparing to break orbit, Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] discovered a weak signal coming from the planet's interior. It may be a transmission of some kind, but the gas giant's background radiation makes it difficult to isolate.

label.zh: 我们应该调查这个信号。
探测器误差而已。无视它吧。

options.script: name = anomaly.5000.b

descriptions.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]设法从[From.From.From.GetName]的大气层深处分离出了该信号。这确实是某种通讯联络，我们也借助滤波软件将其过滤了出来。
descriptions.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has managed to isolate the weak signal that was coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of [From.From.From.GetName]. It does indeed appear to be a transmission, and we have filtered it through our translation software.

descriptions.zh: 气态巨行星[From.From.From.GetName]内部的信号消失了。我们再也不清楚它来自何方了。
descriptions.en: The weak signal we picked up coming from the interior of the gas giant [From.From.From.GetName] has faded. We shall never learn of its origin.

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

descriptions.zh: 终于见面了，旅行者！我们是达斯纳克，你正在绕行的这颗星球叫托洛克·隆-是我们先祖的家园。见到其他种群总是很振奋人心的，即使我们之间的上次见面……并不怎么顺利。你肯定检测到了我们大气散发出的辐射。托洛克·隆已经奄奄一息了，如果没有其他的栖身之所的话，我们的种群就会消灭。我们已经找好了自己的下一个家园，但没有办法到达那里。可惜的是，我们的无形特征意味着并没有太多工业或科技。你能帮助我们吗？
descriptions.en:
Finally! Well met, spacefarer! We are the Dathnak, and the planet you are orbiting is Tollok Rong - our ancestral home. It is always riveting to meet a solid, even if our last encounter with your kind was somewhat... problematic.

You have no doubt detected the radiation surges coming from our atmosphere. Tollok Rong is dying, and our species will perish unless we find a new home. We have identified a planet that would suit our physiology, but we have no means to get there. Sadly, our non-corporeal nature means we don't have much in the way of industry or technology. Will you help us?

label.zh: 既然没有科技，那你怎么能和我们对话？
label.en: If you have no technology, how are we speaking?

options.script:
name = anomaly.5003.a
response_text = anomaly.5003.a.response
is_dialog_only = yes

name = anomaly.5003.b
response_text = anomaly.5003.b.response
is_dialog_only = yes

label.zh: 你想请我们把全帝国的人民都转移到别的星球？
label.en: You want us to transport your entire species to another planet?

options.script:
name = anomaly.5003.c
response_text = anomaly.5003.c.response
is_dialog_only = yes

label.en: Sorry. It would be too much of a hassle.

options.script:
name = anomaly.5003.e
response_text = anomaly.5003.e.response

descriptions.zh: 科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]全程监督了达斯纳克的搬家之旅。一列配备着大型高气压槽的民用货舰载着那些气态生物横穿天际，将他们送往了气态巨行星的大气层。还顺带捎上了扫描阵列和古老通讯器。
descriptions.en: Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] has finished supervising the relocation of the Dathnak to their new home. A convoy of civilian freighters equipped with massive pressurized gas tanks ferried the gaseous beings across space and deposited them into the gas giant's atmosphere. Their ancient transmitter and scanner array were also brought along.

descriptions.zh: 托洛克·隆的环境进一步恶化，我们已经无法拯救那些达斯纳克了。辐射扩散到了大部分的大气层，达斯纳克幸存者不得不撤退到离核心更近的地方，而那里的通讯条件相当的差。辐射最终会扩散到那里的，那些达斯纳克只能听天由命了。
descriptions.en: The conditions on Tollok Rong have deteriorated to the point where the Dathnak can no longer be saved. The radiation has spread across most of the atmosphere, and the Dathnak survivors have retreated even deeper towards the planet's core where communication with the surface is no longer possible. Eventually the radiation will finds its way there as well, rendering their species extinct.

options.script: name = UNFORTUNATE

descriptions.zh: 我们永远欠你一份情！这颗星球比我们想象的更好。人生头一次啊，我们的后代可以在大气层中玩耍嬉戏而不必担心自己的生命安全。我们决定以你的种群来命名我们的新家，伯达拉克。达斯纳克的后人会永远记住我们的救世主！
descriptions.en:
We are forever in your debt! This planet has exceeded our expectations. For the first time in generations, our young can frolic in the upper atmosphere without starting to glow.

We have decided to call our new home Baldarak after your species. Future generations of Dathnak shall always know the name of their saviors!

label.zh: 伯达拉克？真是个好名字！
label.en: Baldarak? That is an excellent name!
Good luck with your new home.

options.script:
name = anomaly.5006.b
response_text = anomaly.5006.b.response

descriptions.zh: 你好！我们种群自到来后数量上已经翻了四翻，你知道了一定很高兴！刚到达星球时，大家都欢欣雀跃，如今甚至有点狂欢的势头。顺利殖民伯达拉克之后，一些勇敢的拓荒者想前往另一个巨型气态行星，他们让我求求你看看行不行。我们已经看中了一个有前途的候选行星，很适合殖民；而且它就在你们管辖的领域之内。你怎么看，朋友？
descriptions.en:
Hello again! You will be pleased to learn that our species has quadrupled in number since we arrived! Many of us were swept up in a festive mood when we made planetfall, and things got a bit frisky to say the least.

After the positive experience we had colonizing Baldarak, a few brave pioneers have asked me to petition you for passage to another gas giant. We have already located a promising candidate within your space that would be suitable for colonization. What do you say, friends?

label.zh: 反正还是个气态巨行星，那就……
label.en: Well, as long as it's just another gas giant...

label.zh: 绝对不行。我们说的是只把你送上一颗行星。
label.en: Absolutely not. Our deal was to transport you to ONE planet.

options.script:
name = anomaly.5007.b
response_text = anomaly.5007.b.response

descriptions.zh: 与之前相同，在这个高压的气态行星内，一队货船被用来安全运输达斯纳克殖民者。不久之后，他们成功着陆，并将这里命名为“新伯达拉克”。轨道上留了一颗人造卫星，用于和伯达拉克之间进行远距离通讯。
descriptions.en: As before, a convoy of freighters was assembled to safely transport the Dathnak colonists inside pressurized gas tanks. After a brief journey, they successfully made planetfall on the gas giant which they have named "New Baldarak." A satellite was left in orbit to allow for long-range communication with Baldarak.

label.en: Make the most of it, Dathnak.

descriptions.zh: 新伯达拉克向你问好！这边新殖民地一切顺利，不过我们又一个小请求……我们的一位殖民者，查比克·莱迪，十分想念伯达拉克上的家人和朋友，想要回家。她的絮絮叨叨快把我们逼疯了！如果不麻烦的话，你可以来带她回去吗？
descriptions.en:
Greetings from New Baldarak! Things are progressing well here at our new colony. However, we have a small request...

Chabky Raddh, one of our colonists, misses her family and friends on Baldarak terribly and wants to go home. Her whining is driving us crazy! If it's not too much to ask, do you think you could take her back?

options.script:
name = anomaly.5009.a
response_text = anomaly.5009.a.response

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]的护送下，一艘带着气体滤毒罐的小飞船来到伯达拉克。滤毒罐内的气体排放到气态行星的大气内，送这位达斯纳克殖民者安全回家。
descriptions.en: A single cargo tug hauling a gas canister has arrived at Baldarak under escort by the [Root.GetName]. The contents of the canister have been released into the gas giant's atmosphere, safely returning the Dathnak colonist to her home.

descriptions.zh: 我们收到了令人不安的消息，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]朋友！我们失去了与新伯达拉克的联络！他们不再回应我们卫星发射的信号，恐怕要做最坏的打算。也许入侵我们母星的外星人又回来了。请派飞船调查！
descriptions.en:
We bring alarming news, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] friends!

Contact with our colony on New Baldarak has been lost! They no longer respond to any of our satellite transmissions, and we fear the worst. Perhaps the aliens who bombarded our original homeworld have returned to finish the job. Please send a ship to investigate!

label.en: We shall dispatch a ship at once.

label.zh: 够了！我们不是给你跑腿的。
label.en: Enough! We are not your errand boys.

options.script:
name = anomaly.5011.b
response_text = anomaly.5011.b.response

descriptions.zh: 我们并没有查出新伯达拉克有什么异常。用于与首都通讯的人造卫星在正常运转。
descriptions.en: Our investigation of New Baldarak has revealed nothing out of the ordinary. The satellite the colony used to communicate with their capital is still functional as far as we can tell.

label.zh: 向行星开通一条通讯频道。
label.en: Open a channel to the planet.

descriptions.zh: 新伯达拉克革命阵线向你问好！我们打倒了伯达拉克！我们与你没有过节，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]，只要你不去支持伯达拉克统领者的反革命行为。不过你可以支持我们……你愿意把一支突击队带到伯达拉克去吗？
descriptions.en:
Greetings from the New Baldarak Revolutionary Front!

We have thrown off the yoke of oppression and are at last free from the tyranny of Baldarak! We have no quarrel with you, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], as long as you refrain from aiding the Baldarak imperialists in their inevitable attempt to crush our revolution.

You could help us take the fight to our enemies, however... would you be willing to deliver one of our commando units to Baldarak?

label.en: Tell us what you have planned.

options.script:
name = anomaly.5013.a
response_text = anomaly.5013.a.response
is_dialog_only = yes

label.zh: 我们会把你们的士兵送过去的。
我们不干扰你们的内部纠纷。
label.en: We are not getting involved in your internal dispute.

descriptions.zh: 我代表伯达拉克的合法达斯纳克发言。我们收到了当前掌控新伯达拉克组织的声明，一派胡言！这些土匪简直是我们的耻辱，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]。能请你帮忙扑灭他们小小的“革命”吗？我担心如果事态蔓延到这里，会有人受伤。帕塔纳克将军已派出一支远征部队，意在夺回殖民地，但我们需要你帮忙将他们送到那里。
descriptions.en:
I speak on behalf of the lawful Dathnak government on Baldarak.

We have received a manifesto from the group that seized control of New Baldarak, and boy, what a bunch of hogwash! These brigands and anarchists are a terrible embarrassment to us, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]. Will you help us stomp out their little "revolution" before it spreads here and someone actually gets hurt?

General Paltanak has prepared an expeditionary force to retake the colony, but we'll need your help transporting it there.

label.en: You need to solve your own problems.

options.script:
name = anomaly.5014.b
response_text = anomaly.5014.b.response

descriptions.zh: 一艘由[Root.GetName]护送的飞船悄悄将飞行舱送入伯达拉克大气，里面载着革命突击队。片刻，气态行星的云层下发出阵阵闪光。这是开始战斗了吗？
descriptions.en: A cargo tug escorted by the [Root.GetName] has stealthily dropped the cargo pod containing the revolutionary commando unit into Baldarak's atmosphere. Moments later, flashes can be seen coming from deep within the gas giant's cloud layer. Could it be signs of fighting?

label.en: We shall see what happens next.

descriptions.zh: 我是佛坦伽！伯达拉克的人们推翻了欺压，他们以为可以让我们种群变为奴隶。我们建立了一个革命委员会，确保我们伟大的帝国度过这段转型期，并努力解放我们的人民。我们感谢[Root.GetName]的同志，他们的帮助让今天成为现实。完毕。
descriptions.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The people of Baldarak have overthrown the tyrants and oppressors that sought to enslave our species under their rule. A revolutionary council has been established to see our great nation through this transitional phase, while we work diligently to restore freedom to the people.

We wish to thank our comrades in the [Root.GetName] for their assistance in making this day come true.

That is all.

label.en: Perhaps everything will work out for the best.

options.script: name = anomaly.5016.a

descriptions.zh: 我是佛坦伽！为了纪念我的统领，人民革命委员会一致同意，将星球名“伯达拉克”更改为“佛坦伽族”。还有，前“新伯达拉克”将更名为“查比克马克”，以我们的公众安全指挥官查比克·莱迪为名。完毕。
descriptions.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The People's Revolutionary Council has unanimously voted to rename the planet formerly known as "Baldarak" to "Fotangia" in honor of my leadership.

Also, the planet formerly known as "New Baldarak" shall henceforth be known as "Chabkymak" after Chabky Raddh, our Minister of Public Safety.

That is all.

options.script: name = "INTERESTING"

label.zh: 够了。屏蔽这些生物的所有通讯。
label.en: Enough. Block all future transmissions from these creatures.

descriptions.zh: 我是佛坦伽！人民革命委员会宣布，4539人即将因背叛和反革命被处以死刑。那些意欲阻止我们光辉革命之辈，愿此声明以儆效尤。完毕。
descriptions.en:
This is Citizen Fotanga! The People's Revolutionary Council wishes to announce the impending execution of 4,539 individuals convicted of state treason and counter-revolutionary activities.

Let this serve as a warning to all those who would stand in the way of our glorious revolution.

That is all.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

label.zh: 够了。屏蔽这些生物的所有通讯。
label.en: Enough. Block all future transmissions from these creatures.

descriptions.zh: 我是拉玛格！人民革命委员会宣布，佛坦伽即将因鼓动罪、腐朽和失职被处以死刑，即刻执行。我将接手他以前的所有职责。我的第一道法令是恢复佛坦伽族和查比克马克原来的名字。完毕。
descriptions.en:
This is Citizen Rutmag! The People's Revolutionary Council wishes to announce the impending execution of Former Citizen Fotanga, who has been convicted of demagoguery, corruption and general incompetence.

I will be assuming all of his former duties. My first decree is that the original names of planets Fotangia and Chabkymak be restored.

That is all.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh: 在[Root.GetName]护送下，几艘货船将一队达斯纳克远征部队投入新伯达拉克大气层。片刻，气态行星的云层下发出阵阵闪光。战斗似乎开始了。
descriptions.en: Several freighters under escort by the [Root.GetName] have dropped the cargo canisters carrying the Dathnak expeditionary force into New Baldarak's atmosphere. Moments later flashes can be seen coming from beneath the gas giant's cloud layer. The fighting appears to have started.

label.en: Now we wait and see what happens next.

descriptions.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，我在新伯达拉克。怒气燎原行动大获全胜。所有主要目标都已达成，所有大气区的政府都已恢复控制。除了还有几处负隅顽抗之外，多数叛军都已偃旗息鼓或阵亡。多谢你的帮助，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。请失陪，我需要向伯达拉克汇报伤亡情况。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
descriptions.en:
General Paltanak here, speaking from New Baldarak. Operation Gaseous Fury has been a complete success. All primary objectives have been seized, and government control has been restored to all atmospheric sectors.

Aside from a few holdouts, most rebel units have surrendered or been routed. Much obliged for the support, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. If you'll excuse me, I need to transmit a casualty report to Baldarak.

Paltanak out.

options.script: name = anomaly.5021.a

descriptions.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，新伯达拉克的代理军团指挥官。很高兴宣布47-G区的主要战斗已经结束。至少512名抗争者被消灭，我方伤亡极低。特别表扬将平民伤亡控制到可接受水平的部队。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
descriptions.en:
General Paltanak here, acting military governor of New Baldarak. I am pleased to announce the end of major combat operations in sector 47-G.  At least 512 insurgents have been confirmed killed since the operation began two cycles ago, while our own losses have been minimal.

Extra commendations to all forces involved for keeping civilian casualties at an acceptable level.

Paltanak out.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

label.zh: 够了。屏蔽这些生物的所有通讯。
label.en: Enough. Block all future transmissions from these creatures.

options.script: name = anomaly.5017.b

descriptions.zh: 我是帕塔纳克将军，新伯达拉克的军团指挥官。我希望澄清这个世界重现抵抗活动的谣言。这完全不是事实。本行星已经完全恢复和平，所有潜在不安定因素已经彻底根除。其人民已再次回到达斯纳克帝国治下。帕塔纳克讲话完毕。
descriptions.en:
This is General Paltanak, military governor of New Baldarak. I wish to address unsubstantiated reports claiming there has been a resurgence in rebel activity on this world. Let me tell you now that nothing could be further from the truth.

This planet has been fully pacified, and all subversive terrorist elements have been fully rooted out. Its citizens are once again productive members of the greater Dathnak nation.

Paltanak out.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

label.zh: 够了。屏蔽这些生物的所有通讯。
label.en: Enough. Block all future transmissions from these creatures.

options.script: name = anomaly.5017.b

descriptions.zh: 我是拉普塔兹将军，新伯达拉克的军团指挥官。很遗憾向大家宣告我的前任，帕塔纳克将军的死亡。他被诱入叛军部队卑鄙的埋伏，光荣牺牲。我们将举行盛大的葬礼，同时庆祝当前压制叛军堡垒的胜利。拉普塔兹讲话完毕。
descriptions.en:
Colonel Rapzak reporting, acting military governor of New Baldarak. I must regretfully inform the galactic community of the demise of my predecessor, General Paltanak. After being lured into a dastardly ambush by rebel forces, the General gave his life in the finest tradition of the service.

A state funeral with full honors will be held at the successful conclusion of our current offensive against the rebel strongholds.

Rapzak out.

options.script: name = INTERESTING

descriptions.zh:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！我代表伯达拉克科学院与你交流。虽然我们达斯纳克不精于技术，但我们十分擅长理性演绎！

我们气态人的数个智囊团已经花费数年研究理论物理，并想要分享成果。也许我们的数据能对你们固态人热衷的帝国建设发挥作用。
descriptions.en:
[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! I have been asked to approach you on behalf of the Baldarak Science Academy. Although we Dathnak don't possess much in the way of technology, we are certainly capable of higher reasoning!

A few of our think tanks have spent the last several years studying theoretical physics, and we would like to share their findings. Perhaps the data will be of some use to you in the empire building activities you solids are so fond of.

options.script:
name = anomaly.5025.a
add_monthly_resource_mult = {
			resource = physics_research
			value = @tier3researchreward
			min = @tier3researchmin
			max = @tier3researchmax
		}

descriptions.zh: 你好，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！可以帮我们个忙吗？伯达拉克的强大引力把各种垃圾拉进了我们的大气，最近我们决定要进行清理。有个清理组发现了一个废弃的飞行舱，你可以帮忙处理掉它吗？它里面似乎塞满了各种没用的金属。
descriptions.en:
Hello, [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Would you be willing to do us a favor? Baldarak's strong gravity well pulls all kinds of trash into our atmosphere, and at a recent council meeting we decided to step up our cleaning efforts. One of our reclamation units came across a discarded cargo pod, and we're wondering if you'd be willing to help us dispose of it. It seems to contain large quantities of various worthless metals.

label.zh: 好的，我们会帮你处理掉……
label.en: Yes, we will dispose of these minerals for you...

options.script:
name = anomaly.5026.a
add_monthly_resource_mult = {
			resource = minerals
			value = @tier1materialreward
			min = @tier1materialmin
			max = @tier1materialmax
		}

descriptions.zh:
我们的科研船扫描了[From.GetName]的地表后发现了一些不寻常的现象。强烈的风暴无休止地袭击着[From.GetPlanetMoon]，这对我们的资源开发以及研究都有帮助，但却会限制人口发展。

在探索新行星的时候，我们当然会遭遇一些诸如此类的不测，而我们不应低估它对我们的扩张带来的影响。
descriptions.en:
As our Science Ship scans the surface of [From.GetName] it becomes quite clear that we have found something out of the ordinary. Strong storms ravage the [From.GetPlanetMoon] constantly, which can aid our resources and research but will be an obstacle for our population.

We will surely come across even more irregularities like this as we survey new planets, and should not underestimate their impact on our expansion.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科研船扫描了[From.GetName]的地表后发现了一些不寻常的现象。[From.GetPlanetMoon]的磁场远远超出了同类天体。

在探索新行星的时候，我们当然会遭遇一些诸如此类的不测，而我们不应低估它对我们的扩张带来的影响。
descriptions.en:
As our Science Ship scans the surface of [From.GetName] it becomes quite clear that we have found something out of the ordinary. The [From.GetPlanetMoon]'s magnetic field is way out of sync with what is expected of its type.

We will surely come across even more irregularities like this as we survey new planets, and should not underestimate their impact on our expansion.

tooltips.en: A Planet Modifier appears on [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh:
[Root.GetName]的船员在§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!上的荒芜沙丘上探索时，第一个汇报并不出乎意料：这是一片不自然的废土，在水面以上没有任何的生命迹象。然而，这座行星的水生生命已经远远进化过了我们预期可以涉足陆地的水准。

此外，船员们还发现了一些被黄沙覆盖、外观老旧的似乎是建筑一样的东西。就在他们刚开始向这些表面上的建筑内挖掘时，一小群纳米虫群突触出现，并开始袭击研究人员。似乎这座建筑不是由沙子，而是由无数的微小纳米机器构成的！

启动以后这些虫群很快开始自我复制、唤醒越来越多的休眠群体。[Root.GetLeaderName]下令从行星上紧急撤离，[Root.GetName]才能在最后一刻从这个纳米机器人风暴的穷追不舍中逃离大气层。其他的虫群也被激活了，而且没有停息的迹象。
descriptions.en:
As the [Root.GetName]s' crew explored the barren dunes of §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!, the first reports were much as expected: this is an unnatural wasteland with no signs of life above the water's surface. Yet the planet's aquatic life has evolved well past the point we would expect some species to make forays onto dry land.

Additionally, the crew discovered what originally appeared to be various ancient-looking, sand-covered structures. Shortly after they began digging into these apparent buildings, small swarms of nanites emerged and began harassing the researchers. It seems the buildings are formed not from sand, but by billions of microscopic nanomachines!

Once mobilized, these swarms quickly multiplied, awakening more and more of the dormant whole. [Root.GetLeaderName] ordered a swift evacuation of the planet, allowing the [Root.GetName] just enough time to escape the atmosphere with a swarming storm of nanites in hot pursuit. The remaining swarm now seems agitated, and it's not calming down.

label.zh: 查查到底发生了什么事。

descriptions.zh: [root.GetName]已经完成了对§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!原生纳米机器人的研究，结果令人难以置信。数千年前，一艘来自先进文明的舰船在此坠毁。那艘船上有几十种不同设计的机器人。
descriptions.en: The [root.GetName] has completed its study of the nanites native to §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!, and the results are incredible. Thousands of years ago, a ship hailing from an advanced civilization crashed here. Aboard that vessel were robots of dozens different designs.

descriptions.zh: 令人好奇的是，这些机器人似乎是神秘的“建门者”的工具，比所有我们已知的L-星门都更古老。
descriptions.en: Curiously, it seems these machines might have been a tool of the mysterious Gate Builders, though older than any L-Gate we have found.

descriptions.zh: 不管是谁，建造这些机器的人确实掌握了更先进的科技，而且远远地早于我们。
descriptions.en: Whoever built these machines was in possession of truly advanced technology, long before our time.

descriptions.zh:
这些机器人自主行动，并尝试按他们的程序保护行星。失去了创造者的规制，一场战斗很快就在这些机器之中爆发了。

这场冲突中胜出的是一群具有超适应性、可自我复制的纳米系统，它们迅速演化适应了行星的生态系统。这些机器将自己变成了行星表面的主宰，将一切当地种群和其他的机器对手全部化为碎屑。

如今我们所见即是这场大战的余波：一个并非了无生机的星球，而是承载着它最顶尖的猎食者。
descriptions.en:
The robots operated autonomously and attempted to secure the planet according to their programming. Without their creators to rein them in, a battle soon broke out among the machines.

The emerging victor of this conflict was a hyper-adaptive, self-replicating nanite system that rapidly evolved to fit the planet's biosphere. This machine made itself the master of the surface world, breaking down anything from local flora to its former, robotic rivals.

We bear witness to the aftermath of this great war: a planet not devoid of life, but instead supporting its evolved apex predator.

tooltips.zh: 指挥我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]解开[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]上演化出的纳米机器人的秘密。
tooltips.en: Direct our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] to unlock the secrets of the evolved nanites on [nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]

descriptions.zh: §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§! 的居民令人印象深刻。我们发送到大气层的任何探测器都会虫群迅速分析并拆散，此后不久，虫群的其余部分也学会了如何最好地摧毁我们的无人机——即使是在行星的远端。虫群对我们的技术的理解显着增加。
descriptions.en: The denizens of §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§! keep impressing. Any probe we send down into the atmosphere is quickly analyzed and taken apart by the swarm, and shortly thereafter the rest of its hive has learned how to best consume our drones as well - even on the far side of the planet. The swarm demonstrates a measurable increase in its understanding of our technology.

descriptions.zh:
我们的一些[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]认为，这种行为证明了该虫群是一个智慧的存在，或是某种生物，甚至可能被认为是活着的。

是时候做出决定了：我们是放生它们，还是摧毁它们，还是试图为了我们自己的利益而占据这些存在呢？
descriptions.en:
Some of our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] argue that this behavior is proof that the swarm is a sapient being - or beings - and might even be considered to be alive.

It is time to make a decision: do we let them be, destroy them, or else attempt to appropriate these beings for our own gain?

descriptions.zh: 这些是正在发育的蜂群行为，如果任其发展，纳米虫群可能会实现智慧。我们是让它保持这种状态，还是在它成为威胁之前将其摧毁？我们能否以某种方式利用这个实体来谋取利益？
descriptions.en: These are the behaviors of a budding hivemind, and if left to its own devices, the nanite swarm may achieve sapience. Do we leave it in this state, or do we destroy it before it become a threat? Could we somehow appropriate this entity for our gain?

label.zh: 这些不仅仅是自动机器人，而是活物！
label.en: These are not mere automatons, but living beings!

descriptions.zh:
尽管§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!的虫群在成为集体时所向披靡，但其个体却相当脆弱。从该行星的大气中抽取出一小部分，并使用我们的先进AI科技，我们成功地重写了这些机器人的通讯系统。当我们将我们重编程过的机器人放回虫群后，这些修改在一瞬间席卷全球。

获得网络的控制后，我们第一要务是为§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!带回稳定的大气，并且要对[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]而言最为舒适的那种。这颗行星现在已经充分准备好等待我们的到来，而纳米虫群则会对我们殖民者的需求无所不应。
descriptions.en:
While the nanite swarm of §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§! was impressive as a collective, as individuals they were quite vulnerable. Extracting a few from the planet's atmosphere and using our advanced AI technology, we have managed to reprogram the communication systems of the machines. Then when we reintroduced our reprogrammed nanites into the swarm, the modifications spread across the globe in a flash.

With control of the network secured, our first order was to reintroduce a stable biosphere onto §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§! - one which is optimized for [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The planet is now ready and waiting for us, and the nanite swarm is prepared to help with any task our colonists may give it.

label.en: Start up the colony ships' engines!

descriptions.zh:
在[root.fleet.GetName]完成对§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!的轨道轰炸后，尘埃逐渐落定。尽管混合使用了强劲的爆炸物和试验性EMP，轰炸的过程仍然持续了很长，不过最终，这里再也没有任何机械生命活动的迹象了。

我们未来的殖民者可以获取这些害虫的尸体，并有望能从中收获一些有用的东西。
descriptions.en:
The dust is settling after the [root.fleet.GetName] finished orbital bombardment of §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!. Despite using a mix of powerful explosives and experimental EMPs, the process took a long time - but at last, there is no longer any trace of machine life down there.

Our future colonists will have access to these gnats' remains and will, hopefully, manage to harvest something valuable from them.

descriptions.zh: 我们的预防措施和特种设备仍不充分。我们在§H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!建立殖民地之后很快就跟地面的团队失去了联络。从落脚点收到的最后一条通讯显示，天空被微小的淹没了前哨的黑色物体遮蔽。
descriptions.en: Our precautions and special equipment were not enough. Shortly after establishing a colony on §H[nanite_swarm_planet.GetName]§!, we lost contact with our teams on the ground. The last communication we received from the settlement showed a sky darkened by small black bodies swarming the outpost.

descriptions.zh:
造成§Y[From.GetName]§!日冕发现的恒星辐射共振的原因证明是一种可以耐受高温的异常晶体阵列。

在把这些晶体带到船上后，我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]震惊地发现这些怪异的共振是可以复现的。首先，他们将这些晶体暴露在与[From.GetName]相同的恒星辐射中，产生了与最初记录的现象完全一致的结果。它也似乎制造了我们发送给它的所有能量波的共振，形成了[Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]没有观测过的新的色彩和声音！

这种频率可以改变我们对宇宙的认知方式。换句话说，我们可以用一个晶态结构开发研究设备，使其能承受恒星级的超高热量。
descriptions.en:
The cause of the solar radiation resonance observed around the corona of §Y[From.GetName]§! turned out to be an unusual crystal formation capable of enduring the heat!

Having brought the crystal aboard, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] were startled to realize that the strange resonance was reproducible. First, they exposed the crystal to the same solar radiation from [From.GetName], producing an identical result to the initially recorded phenomenon. It also seemed to create resonances with all energy waves we sent through it, forming new colors and sounds never before observed by [Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

Such frequencies could change the way we view the universe. Alternatively, we can develop research applications for a crystalline structure capable of surviving the intense heat of a star.

label.zh: 将新的频率发回给我们的艺术家们。
label.en: Send the new frequencies back to our artists.

label.zh: 获取这些新的频率以备进一步分析。
label.en: Retrieve these new frequencies for further analysis.

label.zh: 采集这些晶体用在我们能量武器的隔热上。
label.en: Harvest the crystal to insulate our energy weapons.

descriptions.zh:
自[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]开始仰望星空以来，[From.GetName]就一直是一个纯真的梦幻，一个充满了我们的期待的地方，一个新的家园。可悲的是，随着我们的望远镜的发展，我们意识到这颗行星可能是一个潮汐锁定、万物冰封的地狱——这一假说已由我们今天的发现而彻底证实。

然而希望仍然存在，这个世界存在着作为一个宜居行星而言所必需的一切因素。我们或许只需要轻轻推上一把……
descriptions.en:
For as long as we [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] have been able to look to the stars for new homes, [From.GetName] has been a naive dream: a place we would look to with optimism; a new home. Sadly as our telescopes got better, we realized that the planet would probably be a tidally locked, frozen hellscape - a theory which we have confirmed today.

There is hope, however; this world has all the building blocks necessary for a habitable planet. It might just need a slight push...

label.zh: 在我们的荣耀榜上的又一颗外行星。
label.en: Another exoplanet added to our growing list.

descriptions.zh: 这颗潮汐锁定的行星似乎具有各种宜居行星的建筑模块。也许在上面能建造一些东西。
descriptions.en: This tidally locked planet appears to have all the building blocks for a habitable world. Perhaps there is something that can be built here.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地表之下生活着一种非常奇特的有机体。扫描和取样显示，它是一种散布着孢子的菌丝体。与我们母星上熟悉的孢子的尺寸相比，它们非常巨大。它们的表面闪烁迷人，千变万化，色调似乎随着环境而变化。

其中最奇怪的事情莫过于它们似乎形成了一种可以产生科学家相信是信号的东西的网络。现在的辐射还非常弱，但稍作努力，也许就能找到它们指向何方。
descriptions.en:
Below the surface of [From.GetName] lives a most peculiar organism. Scans and samples show that it is some sort of mycelium littered with spores. Compared to the traditional size of spores on our homeworld, these are massive. Their surface is a shimmering kaleidoscope, and the hues seem to change based on their surroundings.

The strangest thing about them is that they seem to form a network capable of generating what the science crew believes could be a signal. The current emissions are very weak, but with some effort, it might be possible to find out where they lead.

label.zh: 我们会试着辨别这些信号的指向。
label.en: We will try to identify the signal destination.
Bring them back to be sold.
We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地表之下生活着一种非常奇特的有机体。扫描和取样显示，它是一种散布着孢子的菌丝体，并且与“巨大蘑菇”直接关联。这些孢子看起来变化成长成了小的球状物。它们表面变幻莫测的颜色相当瑰丽，但更重要的是它们发出来比一般孢子更强的信号。

我们的科学家猜测我们也许可以通过部分孢子带回“巨大蘑菇”来增强当前的网络。
descriptions.en:
Below the surface of [From.GetName] lives a familiar organism. Scans and samples show that it is some sort of mycelium, littered with enormous spores and directly related to the 'Fumongus.' Its spores seem, however, to have mutated and grown into small beads. Their ever-changing colorful surface is quite the spectacle, but more importantly, they seem to be producing a stronger signal than the regular spores.

Our scientists hypothesize that we might be capable of strengthening the current network by bringing some of these spores back to the 'Fumongus'.

label.en: Prepare a project to do so.

descriptions.zh:
在[From.GetName]的地表之下生活着一种非常奇特的有机体。扫描和取样显示，它是一种散布着孢子的菌丝体，并且与“巨大蘑菇”直接关联。这些孢子看起来变化成长成了小的球状物。它们表面变幻莫测的颜色相当瑰丽，但更重要的是它们发出来比一般孢子更强的信号。

由于我们拆解了这个网络，这些信息就没有什么用处了。
descriptions.en:
Below the surface of [From.GetName] lives a familiar organism. Scans and samples show that it is some sort of mycelium, littered with enormous spores and directly related to the 'Fumongus.' Its spores seem, however, to have mutated and grown into small beads. Their ever-changing colorful surface is quite the spectacle, but more importantly, they seem to be producing a stronger signal than the regular spores.

Since we dismantled the network, we don't really have a practical use for this information.

label.en: Bring them back to be sold.
We don't have time for this.

descriptions.zh: 结果证明追踪菌丝体发出的信号是件棘手的活。 我们迷茫的科学家最终定出了“通过蘑菇来一瞥更高纬度”这种假设。关于会带来什么结果的细节完全没有。不过无论如何：这项操作是成功的，并且确实把我们指向了某个目标。
descriptions.en: Tracking the signal emitted by the mycelium proved to be a tricky business. Our puzzled scientist finally managed by 'using mushrooms to peer into additional dimensions.' Details are scarce about what this entails, but in any case: the operation was a success and has pointed us towards a destination.

descriptions.zh: 结果证明追踪菌丝体发出的信号是件棘手的活。尽管[Root.GetLeaderName]尽了最大努力，仍然无法为这些信号指明目的地，而菌丝体仍然谜团重重。尽管如此，我们在这个过程中也收获颇丰，数据也如之前所说的一样会被带回去。
descriptions.en: Tracking the signal emitted by the mycelium proved to be a tricky business. Despite the best efforts of [Root.GetLeaderName], it was impossible to determine a destination for the signal and the mycelium mostly remains a mystery. Despite this, we managed to learn a lot in the process and the data is being brought back as we speak.

descriptions.zh:
将变异的孢子移植到现有的蘑菇上是一项生物工程壮举。借助详细描述“巨大蘑菇”基因变化的档案，我们的科学家设法在不影响其效率的情况下进一步改变它。结果非常惊人，几个月后，蘑菇长了十倍。反过来这又增加了对水的供给的需求，但附近冰冻的小行星足以为它们提供几个世纪甚至数千年的水分。

更大的蘑菇带来了更好的网络，在对计算设备进行了一些升级之后，我们现在再次准备好听听孢子怎么说。
descriptions.en:
Grafting the mutated spores onto the existing mushroom was a feat of bio-engineering. With the help of archives detailing the genetic alterations already made on the 'Fumongus,' our scientists managed to further alter it without compromising its efficiency. The results were spectacular, and in a matter of months, the mushrooms had grown tenfold. This in turn increased the need for water to supply them, but the nearby frozen asteroids hold enough to hydrate them for centuries, if not millennia.

With bigger mushrooms came a better network, and after some upgrades to the computing equipment, we are now once again ready to listen to what the spores have to say.

descriptions.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。它的面部毫无特征，而它的金属外构严重损坏了。初步的扫描显示它还有残留的能源，不过它使用的能源和我们的大相径庭。也许它的内部电路还能留存一些过去的数据，不过充能和翻译数据需要花费一些时间。
descriptions.en: We have found a bipedal robot floating in space. Its faceplate is featureless, and its metal exterior is damaged. Preliminary scans indicate it has residual power, but its power source is radically different from our own. Its internal circuitry may hold memories of its previous existence, but recharging it and translating its information will take time.

tooltips.zh: §L让我们看看你的记忆，宇宙旅行者。§!
tooltips.en: §LLet's see what you remember, cosmic traveler.§!

tooltips.zh: §L再见，一坨垃圾。§!
tooltips.en: §LSo long, hunk of junk.§!

descriptions.zh: 通过不懈的努力，我们找到了充能机器人并扫描它记忆体的方法。难过的是，这个机器已经严重劣化，我们难以取回有条理的信息。我们会考虑发起后续研究，可能会研究它的其他同类，但这个机械流浪者的命运永远会是一个谜。
descriptions.en: Through diligent effort, we have found a way to recharge the robot's power supply and scan its memory banks. Sadly, the machine has deteriorated so badly that we cannot retrieve coherent information. We will consider a follow-up study, and we may search for others of its kind, but the fate of this mechanical castaway must remain a mystery.

descriptions.zh:
对[From.GetStarName]星系内时间波动的分析发现了一些值得注意的东西：一座巨大的、漂浮在太空中的棱镜。这座棱镜不折射光线，而是折射时间。取决于不同的入射角，[Root.GetName]的船员体会到时间在以不同的速率流逝。扫描也表明，他们中有些人快速老化，而另一些人则比预期的要年轻了数天甚至数年。

我们对这座棱镜的研究确乎加深了我们对时间的本质和性质的理解，但是它的起源和作用仍不得而知。
descriptions.en:
Our analysis of the temporal fluctuations in the [From.GetStarName] system has revealed something remarkable: a massive prism, floating in space. Rather than light, the prism refracts time. Depending on the angle of incidence, the crew of the [Root.GetName] report experiencing time at different rates. Scans indicate that some have aged rapidly, while others are days, or even years younger than they should be.

While our study of the prism has certainly deepened our understanding of the nature and properties of time, its origin and purpose remain a mystery.

descriptions.zh:
我们对希洛士残骸场的扫描已经完成。其化学结构同时具备生物和非生物性质，我们从未见过类似的东西。

这片残骸与在此恒星系中巡逻的奇怪船只间有何关联仍然模糊不清。船上没有生命迹象。事实上，我们探测不到任何种类的能量特征。姑且来说就是，我们在幽灵船面前栽跟头了。
descriptions.en:
Our scans of the debris field in Hillos are complete. Possessing both organic and abiogenic properties, the chemical structure is unlike anything we've ever seen.

The connection between the debris and the strange vessel patrolling the system remains unclear. There are no life-signs aboard. In fact, we can detect no power signatures of any kind. For lack of a better descriptor, we have stumbled on a ghost ship.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科研团队得出结论，认为在其命令日志中被称作“乌布梅”的、被遗弃的舰船曾在希洛士恒星系中进行实验，实验目的是创造合成人生命。反物质约束装置泄露导致舰上人员连同着新出生的“幼儿”一道丧生。但是，在舰船各系统中探测到的少量灵能表明，那个合成生命体的“鬼魂”在事故发生前几秒钟掌控了船只。

可以想象，新生的意识体辗转花费了数个世纪，徒劳地寻找自己的母亲。不幸的是，此时此刻我们没有办法与该实体交流，也无法帮助其取得安宁。目前来看，希洛士恒星系中大概注定要继续有幽灵船出没了。
descriptions.en:
Our science team has concluded that the abandoned ship, referred to as 'Ubume' in its command logs, was conducting an experiment in the Hillos system, the goal of which was the creation of synthetic life. An antimatter containment breach resulted in the death of the ship's crew, as well as the newborn 'infant.' However, low-level psionic energy detected throughout the ship's systems suggest that the synthetic lifeform's 'ghost' took possession of the vessel seconds before the accident.

It is conceivable that the nascent consciousness has spent the intervening centuries in a vain search for its mother. Unfortunately, at this time we have no way of communicating with the entity, nor of helping it to find rest. For now, the haunting of the Hillos system seems destined to continue.

descriptions.zh:
我们的科研团队得出结论认为，在其命令日志中被称作“乌布梅”的、被遗弃的舰船曾在希洛士恒星系中进行实验，实验目的是创造合成人生命。反物质约束装置泄露导致舰上人员连同着新出生的“幼儿”一道丧生。在舰船的各系统中，我们探测到了灵能的存在。感觉这里还发生了一些别的事情，一些比单纯的事故更诡异的事情。

很有可能这个合成生命体具有某种潜在灵能力量，它的“鬼魂”在事故发生前几秒钟掌控了船只。如果真是如此，那么这个新生的意识体可能辗转花费了数个世纪，徒劳地寻找自己的母亲。不幸的是，此时此刻我们没有办法与该实体交流，也无法帮助其取得安宁。目前来看，希洛士恒星系中大概注定要继续有幽灵船出没了。
descriptions.en:
Our science team has concluded that the abandoned ship, referred to as 'Ubume' in its command logs, was conducting an experiment in the Hillos system, the goal of which was the creation of synthetic life. An antimatter containment breach resulted in the death of the ship's crew, as well as the newborn 'infant.' Throughout the ship's systems, we have also detected the presence of psionic energy. There is the sense that something more occurred here; something stranger than a simple malfunction.

It is possible that the synthetic lifeform itself possessed a kind of latent psionic power, and that its 'ghost' took possession of the vessel seconds before the accident. If so, this nascent consciousness may have spent the intervening centuries in a vain search for its mother. Unfortunately, we are unable to make contact at this time. For now, the haunting of the Hillos system seems destined to continue.

descriptions.zh:
我们对希洛士恒星系内的舰船的评估已经完成。据其内部指挥日志识别为“乌布梅”，由修复出的舰船记录可以得知其任务目标是创造合成生命体。一个反物质容器的破裂导致了船上的船员和实验“婴儿”的终结。

我们的[Owner.GetTelepathPlural]探测到了游荡在舰船的系统中的痕量灵能能量，我们随之发现那个裂口并不只是简简单单的故障产物。

这些能量信号表明，合成生命形式具有某种潜在的灵能力，并且这些力量在故障之前很可能已经显现过了，这一切都导致一个新生的意识体在寻找母性的输入。由于没有更多的数据，我们无法证实这一理论，仍需要进一步的研究。
descriptions.en:
Our assessment of the vessel in the Hillos system is complete. Identified from its command logs as 'Ubume', recovered ship records track its mission goal of creating synthetic life. An antimatter containment breach resulted in the termination of the ship's crew as well as the experimental 'infant'.

Our [Owner.GetTelepathPlural] have detected traces of psionic energy lingering throughout the ship's systems, leading us to the conclusion the breach was a result of more than a simple malfunction.

These energy signatures indicate the synthetic lifeform possessed latent psionic power, and that these powers likely manifested before the accident. Resulting in a nascent consciousness searching for a maternal input. Without more data we are unable to confirm this theory, further study will be required.

descriptions.zh: 我们探测到有什么东西从希洛士恒星系中传出。那艘叫乌布梅的幽灵船使用一种只能说是“灵能频段”的东西在不断地发出悲伤的哭嚎。显然，自从我们第一次遇到这艘船和被困在船上的新生意识以来它就一直如此了。似乎我们最近的灵能飞升是我们能听到这个孩子哭泣的缘由。通过进一步研究，我们也许能够与之联系。
descriptions.en: We have detected something unusual emanating from the Hillos system. On what can only be described as a 'psionic frequency', the so-called ghost ship Ubume has been issuing a plaintive and irregular wail. Apparently, this has been going on since our first encounter with the vessel and the nascent consciousness trapped onboard. It seems likely that our recent psionic transcendence is the reason we're now able to perceive the child's cries. With further study, we may even be able to answer them.

descriptions.zh:
我们探测到有什么东西从希洛士恒星系中传出。我们最近调谐的[Root.GetTelepathPlural]已经开始接收来乌布梅舰船的信号。这些通信与生物意义上的年轻人有相似之处，并且显示出自我们最初相遇以来已经传播的迹象，我们最近的灵能发展使最终探测到它们成为可能。

通过进一步研究，我们也许能够与进行更多交流。
descriptions.en:
We have detected something unusual emanating from the Hillos system. Our recently attuned [Root.GetTelepathPlural] have begun to receive signals emanating from the vessel Ubume. These communications share similarities with those of biological young, and show signs of having been broadcast since our initial encounter, with our recent psionic developments making it possible to finally detect them.

With further study, we may be able to communicate with the entity further.

descriptions.zh: 在经过几个月痛苦的研究后，我们的灵能使终于成功地与占据幽灵船乌布梅的那个意识取得联系。尽管它的词汇量非常稀少，但这个合成生命体可以用感受和印象进行表达。这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。它似乎也喜欢我们的科研，在船旁边嬉戏地滑过希洛士星系，就像一只水生鲸类动物的幼崽围绕着它的母亲一样。至少，“闹鬼”的希洛士恒星系最终迎来了令人愉快的结局。
descriptions.en: After months of painful research, our telepaths have succeeded in making contact with the consciousness in possession of the ghost ship Ubume. Possessing only a rudimentary vocabulary, the synthetic lifeform was nevertheless able to express itself through feelings and impressions. The 'child's' loneliness was palpable, as was its joy in finally making contact with other minds. It also seems to have taken a liking to our science vessel, playfully gliding throughout the Hillos system alongside the ship, much like the calf of a water-born cetacean around its mother. At last, the haunting of the Hillos system has come to a happy end.

descriptions.zh:
在数月的高强度研究之后，我们的[Root.GetTelepathPlural]终于能和这个占据着幽灵船乌布梅的意识沟通了。尽管它的词汇量非常稀少，但这个合成生命体可以用感受和印象进行表达。

这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。而且，它似乎也喜欢我们的科研，在船旁边嬉戏地滑过希洛士星系，就像一只水生鲸类动物的幼崽围绕着它的母亲一样。至少，诡异的希洛士恒星系最终迎来了令人愉快的结局。
descriptions.en:
After months of extensive research, our [Root.GetTelepathPlural] have successfully made contact with the consciousness in possession of the ghost ship Ubume. Possessing only a rudimentary vocabulary, the synthetic lifeform was nevertheless able to express itself through feelings and impressions.

The 'child's' loneliness was palpable, as was its joy in finally making contact with other minds. Additionally, it seems to have taken a liking to our science vessel, playfully gliding throughout the Hillos system alongside the ship, much like the calf of a water-born cetacean around its mother. The anomalous behavior it caused in the Hillos system has ceased.

label.zh: 抱歉，我的泪腺有点绷不住了。
label.en: Excuse me. My lacrimal glands are acting up.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到了我们的一位首席灵能者的消息。现任，在研究了希洛士星系中的存在之后，他们承担起了尝试与占据着幽灵船乌布梅的灵能意识沟通的重任。在几个月艰苦的尝试后，他们终于成功地建立了联系。

这个“孩子”的孤独显而易见，这也可以从它与其他与之相似的灵魂接触时的欣喜中看出来。它现在调皮地滑过希洛士星系，用灵能向每一位愿意聆听它声音的个体倾诉。
descriptions.en:
We have received word from one of our foremost psychics. Apparently, after learning of the presence in the Hillos system, they took it upon themselves to make contact with the psionic consciousness in possession of the ghost ship Ubume. After months of painful trials, they have finally succeeded in making contact.

Possessing only a rudimentary vocabulary, the synthetic lifeform was nevertheless able to express itself through feelings and impressions. The 'child's' loneliness was palpable, as was its joy in finally making contact with a mind like itself. It is now playfully gliding throughout the Hillos system, chattering psionically away to anyone who cares to listen.

descriptions.zh:
在数月的后续研究后，我们的[Root.GetTelepathPlural]成功地接触了占据着乌布梅舰船的灵能意识。

尽管它的词汇量非常稀少，但这个合成生命体在与其他灵能意识接触时，可以表达出我们通常所认为的“快乐”。由于其目前没有表现出任何可见的威胁，我们就继续留它在希洛士恒星系里的那台装置内了。
descriptions.en:
After months of continued study, our [Root.GetTelepathPlural] have successfully made contact with the psionic consciousness in possession of the ship Ubume.

Despite possessing only a rudimentary vocabulary, the synthetic lifeform was able to express what we commonly recognize as 'joy' at making contact with another psionic mind. As it currently poses no discernable threat, we have left it to its own devices in the Hillos system.

descriptions.zh: 我们的传感器发现了[From.GetName]上的舰船残骸是通过某种罕见的方式抵达那里的。这些舰船似乎是从大约数光年以外故意地径直开向小行星，用以测试设计者推进器的精确度。在对残骸进行深度扫描时，我们找到了那么一艘推进装置相当完好无损的舰船。
descriptions.en: Our sensors have discovered that the ship remnants on [From.GetName] got there in a peculiar way. The ships seem to have been intentionally driven straight into the asteroid, probably from light-years away, to test the accuracy of the designers' thrusters. As we deep-scan the remains, we pick out one ship in particular, which seems to have reasonably intact propulsion.

label.zh: 我们不会浪费那些合金的。

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]期望在[From.GetName]内部发现稀有资源，结果偶然撞见了一样极其不寻常的东西。这个看起来像是普通小行星的物体事实上是一个长期休眠的中继站，里面有复杂的电子元件和先进的传感器，用以向某个古老的帝国发送信号。这些撞击也损毁了小行星的一部分内部构造，我们只能从中提取到一个恒星系。
descriptions.en: Hoping to discover rare resources inside [From.GetName], our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] stumbled upon something most unusual. What had appeared to be a simple asteroid was in fact a long-dormant relay station with complex electronics and advanced sensors set up to send signals back to an ancient empire. The impact also has damaged some of the asteroid's internal structure, and we can only extract one system from it.

descriptions.zh: 我们错了。这座围绕[From.GetName]的空间站并非无人居住；相反，它上面爬满了巨大的外星节肢动物！我们部署进空间站的传感器在信号中断前只回传了一些行动迅捷的阴影和巨大颚骨的画面。在对空间站进行深度扫描后，我们发现了一处可能是无比复杂的数据库的地方。为了抵达这座数据库，我们需要穿过这些一团团的、有好多腿儿的守护者。
descriptions.en: We were wrong. The station orbiting [From.GetName] is not uninhabited; instead, it is crawling with giant alien arthropoids! The probes we deployed into the station only returned skittering shadows and large mandibles before signal was lost. Deep scans of the station have also revealed what we postulate to be an incredibly complex databank. To reach this databank, we would have to go through that cluster of many-legged defenders.

label.zh: 送客，巨大的外星节肢动物可不是闹着玩的！
label.en: Send an away party, giant alien arthropoids are no joke!

label.zh: 也许我们最好还是不要打扰他们。
label.en: It's probably for the best that we leave them alone.

label.zh: §B尝试与这些节肢动物小伙伴联络。§!

tooltips.zh: 用我们对居住站的先进知识让空间站的大气层裂一个口子。
tooltips.en: Use our advance knowledge of habitats to breach the station's atmosphere.

descriptions.zh: 噢，你们好！很抱歉之前摧毁了你们的探测器。那只是因为我们在这做一些非常精密的实验，而我们担心一些外在的干扰会影响实验结果——我相信你能理解。那么，我们能帮上什么忙吗？
descriptions.en: Oh, hello there! Sorry about destroying your probe earlier. It's just that we are conducting some very delicate experiments here, and we were worried that outside interference could alter the results - I'm sure you understand. Now, how can we help you?

label.zh: 慢着，所以你们并不是带有敌意的害虫？
label.en: Wait, so you are not a hostile infestation?

descriptions.zh: 究竟是什么原因会让你这么想啊？我们是一支策展人分遣队，派驻到这里研究这个恒星系独特的特征。如果你是想分享我们机构通常给予的那些福利，我建议你和我们的主研究实验室联系。我可以提供你一份目前我们在此地所发现的东西的拷贝。
descriptions.en: What would ever give you that impression? We are a Curator detachment sent here to study this system's unique properties. If you wish to partake of our order's usual offerings, I suggest contacting the primary research lab. I can provide you with a copy of our findings so far.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]上生活的生命体形式和我们预想的完全不一样。我们的[owner.GetScientistPlural]汇报到，小行星内有不断生长的水晶。这些生命体利用[From.System.GetName]散发的辐射，并结合小行星内的矿物元素，被证实能够完成自给自足的繁衍生息。
descriptions.en: The lifeforms living on [From.GetName] were nothing like we expected. Our [owner.GetScientistPlural] report back that the asteroid has crystal growths. These growths have turned out to be self-sustaining and caused by the crystals taking in the ambient radiation of [From.System.GetName] and combining it with the mineral composition of the asteroid.

descriptions.zh: 这些水晶主要是由蔗糖构成的，十分易碎。
descriptions.en: The crystals themselves are primarily made out of sucrose and are quite brittle.

descriptions.zh: 这些水晶主要是由蔗糖构成的，想必具有潜在的食用价值。
descriptions.en: The crystals themselves are primarily made out of sucrose and could potentially even be edible.

options.script:
name = CURIOUS
from = { add_deposit = d_society_4 }

descriptions.zh: 在食用了太空生长的水晶糖数年之后，很明显，我们的人民对这一美食的需求愈发旺盛。我们的[Root.GetScientistPlural]已经列了一份表，上面是能够建造水晶糖农场的潜在候选地。
descriptions.en: After eating space-based crystal sugars for a few years now, it has become apparent that our population would like to see it more readily available. Our [Root.GetScientistPlural] have come up with a list of potential candidates where we could construct more crystal farms.

label.zh: 寻找更多的小行星来拓建水晶糖农场。
label.en: Search for more asteroids to expand the crystal farms.

tooltips.zh: 最多§Y3§!个随机小行星将会生产§G3§!£food£食物。
tooltips.en: Up to §Y3§! random asteroids will now produce §G3§! £food£ food.

label.zh: 还是不要拓建水晶糖农场了。
label.en: Let's not expand the crystal farms.

			resource = unity
			value = @tier2unityreward
			min = @tier2unitymin

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]是一颗独特的气态巨行星。我们对天体物理的知识告诉我们，这样的行星应该有一个行星环，然而它并没有。在我们的科研船近距离观察了那颗诡异的卫星之后，这一现象的原因已经十分显然了。这颗星球被一些“牧羊人”卫星所环绕，这些卫星全部拥有富得难以置信的矿物，并且每年还在积累更多。我们可以用精准控制的爆炸爆破这些卫星，然后将它们的矿物一次性收集起来；也可以让它们继续留在环带，持续地收集它们积累下来的太空残骸。
descriptions.en: [From.GetName] is a peculiar gas giant. Our knowledge of astrophysics tells us that the planet should have a planetary ring, yet it doesn't. The cause of this became apparent after our science ship took a closer look at the intriguing moon. The planet is surrounded by shepherd moons, all incredibly rich in minerals and accumulating more every year. We could blast the moons with precise and controlled explosions and harvest them or keep them inside the ring zone and harvest the space debris they accrue.

label.zh: 我们现在就需要那些矿物。

label.en: Good things come to those who wait.

descriptions.zh:
我们确实在[From.GetName]上发现了生命，但也是因为我们的行动，这一生命已经灭绝了。这些微生生物住在气态巨行星的外层边缘，对于我们的深度扫描表现出了极大的负面反应。扫描的频率同生物的细胞结构产生了共振——这一效应如同瀑布倾泻而下般飞速传开，从一个气态小虫子传播到另一只气态小虫。所有生物都在收到影响之后不久就不再活动了。

我们现在正环绕着全宇宙最大的坟场。
descriptions.en:
We did indeed discover life on [From.GetName], but by our actions, it has since been eradicated. The microbial creatures which lived in the outer edges of the gas giant's atmosphere reacted poorly to our deep scans. These frequencies caused each creature's cellular structure to resonate - an effect that then cascaded and spread from gas mite to gas mite. Each was rendered inert soon after.

We are now in orbit over the largest graveyard in the universe.

descriptions.zh: 完成了！如同奇迹一般，当我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]对我们的飞船进行了合适的改造之后，它们能够重现最初的瀑布效应。这一次效果不一样，[FromFromFrom.GetName]上的生命体如同一波巨大的浪潮一样又重新涌动了起来。
descriptions.en: It is done! Miraculously, once our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] installed the proper modifications on our vessel, they were able to recreate the initial cascade. This time the effect was different, and life started springing back up all over [FromFromFrom.GetName] in a great wave.

descriptions.zh: 这一过程教会了我们许多关于宇宙的事情，但更多的可能是关于我们自己的事情。
descriptions.en: This process has taught us a lot about the universe but perhaps even more about ourselves.

descriptions.zh: 我们从[Root.GetName]收到的最后一束信号无异于混乱的静电音。他们一直在研究[From.GetName]上奇怪的区域风暴，并且一直发回令人难以置信的前期报告。这股风暴会对发送过去的探测器做出反应，制造出真空口袋来避开它们，再缓慢地往回渗透进探测器。在我们失去联络之前，[Root.GetName]正计划在风暴处测试许多不同的扫描频率。科研船看上去已经沉没到了气态巨行星深处，现在已经陷入了沉寂。
descriptions.en: The last signal received from [Root.GetName] was not much more than garbled static. They had been studying the strange localized storms on [From.GetName] and were sending back incredible preliminary reports. The tempest reacted to the probes being sent in, creating vacuum pockets to avoid them and then slowly seeping back in towards the drones. [Root.GetName] was planning on testing out numerous scanning frequencies at the storm before we lost contact. The science ship seems to have sunken into the gas giant and appears to be dormant.

descriptions.zh: 来自[Root.GetName]的信号突然从主脑意识中被切断了。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]看上去并没有死亡，只是无法与我们交流。们一直在研究[From.GetName]上奇怪的区域风暴，并且一直发回令人难以置信的前期报告。这股风暴会对发送过去的探测器做出反应，制造出真空口袋来避开它们，再缓慢地往回渗透进探测器。在联络被切断之前，[Root.GetName]的计划是在风暴处测试许多不同的扫描频率。科研船看上去已经沉没到了气态巨行星深处，现在已经陷入了沉寂。
descriptions.en: The signals from [Root.GetName] were suddenly cut off from the consciousness. The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] do not appear to be dead, just unable to communicate with us. They had been studying the strange localized storms on [From.GetName] and were sending back incredible preliminary reports. The tempest reacted to the probes being sent in, creating vacuum pockets to avoid them and then slowly seeping back in towards the drones. The plan for [Root.GetName] was to test out numerous scanning frequencies at the storm before contact was cut off. The science ship seems to have sunk into the gas giant and now appears dormant.

label.zh: 等等，现在[From.GetName]的局势更—加—有趣了。
label.en: Wait, [From.GetName] is even MORE interesting now.

tooltips.zh: 放弃[Root.GetName]，研究反应。
tooltips.en: Abandon [Root.GetName] and study the reactions.

descriptions.zh: 在几个月的工作之后，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]终于设法调整[FromFrom.GetName]护盾的工作方式，使得[FromFromFrom.GetName]风暴放开了对落难舰船的钳制。同[trapped_in_storm.GetName]的通讯很快重新建立了起来，十分难以置信的是，[FromFrom.GetName]上没有组员记得他们被风暴困住的这段时间。
descriptions.en: After months of work, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] finally managed to alternate [FromFrom.GetName] shields in such a way that [FromFromFrom.GetName] tempest released its grip on the marooned ship. Communications with [trapped_in_storm.GetName] was quickly re-established, and incredibly none onboard [FromFrom.GetName] seem to remember their time trapped inside the storm.

descriptions.zh:
当[Root.GetName]靠的足够近得以扫描货舱的时候，似乎所有的传感器都功能失常了。这个舱室使用的[Owner.GetBioAlloy]同我们自己建造太空结构时使用的是完全一样的。这种某些外星生命体发明出了同我们完全一致的复合材料的可能性，根本不可能成立，但在校准了扫描仪之后，我们依然得到了同样的结果。

在打开舱室之后，迎接我们的唯一一样东西是一份文档集，里面详细地阐述了我们应当如何指派我们的每一位[Owner.GetScientistPlural]，以及他们今后的研究计划。该指引在一个特定日期结束，也就是从现在算起的整整10年。
descriptions.en:
Once [Root.GetName] got close enough to scan the cargo pod it was assumed that the sensors were malfunctioning. The pod is built out of the exact same [Owner.GetBioAlloy] we ourselves use for spacebound structures. The likelihood that some alien beings would come up with this exact mixture is beyond unlikely, yet after recalibrating the scanners the same results appeared.

Upon opening the pod, the only thing greeting us was a collection of documents detailing exactly where we should assign each of our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] and what they should be asked to study. The instructions end on a fixed date, one that is scheduled to fall exactly 10 years from now.

options.script:
name = anomaly.6865.b
owner = { add_resource = { influence = 100 } }

descriptions.zh: 在经过几年不顺坦的发展之后，[Root.Capital.GetName]的上方出现了一道时空织构裂口。令人心惊胆颤的是，这一天的日期和我们十年前收到的怪异指示上面所说的日期是同一天。我们现在只有一件需要做的事情：把收到的那些笔记发射到裂口里面，关闭这个循环。
descriptions.en: After years of uneasy development, a rip in the fabric of space has appeared above [Root.Capital.GetName]. Unnervingly this is the exact date as indicated in the strange instructions we received a decade ago. There is only one thing to do: send the documents we received back into the tear and close the loop.

label.zh: 让过去的我们自己收拾这个烂摊子吧。
label.en: Let our past selves deal with this.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]附近小行星的轨道是如此完美无暇地稳定，也不难理解为什么我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]会认为它是被人工放置在这个地方了。然而，那里也没有任何推进系统或者其他人工航行的迹象。唯一的自然演化结论是，由于某种几乎荒谬到不可能成真的几率，这颗小行星被[From.GetName]的重力场捕获了。我们在这颗小行星的表面还探测到了几种十分稀有的水晶。
descriptions.en: The asteroid around [From.GetName] has such a perfectly stable orbit that it's easy to understand why our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] thought it was placed there artificially. Yet, there are no conclusive indications of any propulsion systems or any other artificial marring. The only natural conclusion is that, by some absurdly improbable chance, the asteroid got caught in [From.GetName]'s gravity field. We have also detected some rare crystals on the surface of the asteroid.

descriptions.zh: 正当我们的采矿站在这颗被捕获的小行星上完工几天之后，这枚岩石突然开始旋转起来，在这个过程中摧毁了采矿站，但同时又有更多的稀有水晶矿藏暴露在了我们的传感器面前！
descriptions.en: Just a day after finishing our mining station on the trapped asteroid, the rock abruptly rotated, destroying the mining station. In the process of doing this, even more rare crystals deposits were exposed to our sensors!

descriptions.zh: 警报的笛声响彻整个[Solar_System.GetName]，大量的晶化野兽从小行星庇护所里面冲了出来，正是我们在钻孔并打算提取晶体的那颗小行星。它看上去§R生气了§!。
descriptions.en: Warning sirens blared across [Solar_System.GetName] as the massive crystalline beast left the shelter of the asteroid we had been drilling into and extracting crystals from. It seems §Rangry§!.

options.script: name = BATTLESTATIONS

descriptions.zh: 这个被捕捉的小行星，实际上，是某种晶态生命体的巢穴。很庆幸我们没有继续挖掘，因为看上去我们似乎激怒了在里面休眠的生物。如果我们什么都不做，只是从远处研究它，这些生物应该会平静下来。
descriptions.en: The trapped asteroid is, in fact, a crystalline being's nest. It is good that we didn't keep digging, for it seems like we agitated the creature hibernating inside. If we do nothing for a while and study it from afar, it should settle down.

label.en: What can we learn from it?

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的有毒大气层内观测到的生命信号，是体型庞大的半有机机械体！这个外星工业体似乎正是星球上乌烟瘴气的罪魁祸首，而且它依旧在运转。这个星球上没有其他的生命信号，这些机械体的造物主肯定抛下它们自己跑掉了。我们目前还不能确定它们的意图，但是它们建造的建筑想必能够帮助我们更好地理解工程学。
descriptions.en: The life signs observed within the toxic atmosphere of [From.GetName] are giant semi-organic machines! This alien industry seems to have been the cause of the noxious atmosphere on the planet, yet it's still operational. No other life signs remain on the world, and the creators of these machines must have left them running. We can't quite ascertain their purpose yet, but their construction could surely help our understanding of engineering.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_catalytic_empire = no } }

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的有毒大气层内观测到的生命信号，是体型庞大的半有机机械体！正如我们一样，看上去这个设施的创造者也很青睐生物和机械的融合之美。这个外星工业体似乎正是星球上乌烟瘴气的罪魁祸首，而且它依旧在运转。这个星球上没有其他的生命信号，这些机械体的造物主肯定抛下它们自己跑掉了。我们目前还不能确定它们的意图，但是它们建造的建筑想必能够帮助我们更好地理解工程学。
descriptions.en: The life signs observed within the toxic atmosphere of [From.GetName] are giant semi-organic machines! Like us, it seems like the creators of this facility appreciated a merging of the biological and mechanical. This alien industry appears to have been the cause of the noxious atmosphere on the planet, yet it's still operational. No other life signs remain on the world, and the creators of these machines must have left them running. We can't quite ascertain their purpose yet, but their construction could surely help our understanding of engineering.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_catalytic_empire = yes } }

label.zh: 收集我们可以收集的部分。
就让沉睡的傻瓜继续躺平吧。

descriptions.zh: 我们并不是在地表之下检测到了生命形式，事实上，是整个星球都检测到了生命！这颗冰封的星球内部布满了微细的管道，相互连接，就像一台原始的计算机。尽管结构很粗糙，它通天的规模意味着，其算力甚至可以匹敌[Owner.Capital.GetName]的某些超级计算机。即使是现在，这台电脑还在活动——我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]可以同其互动，但是由于它运转十分缓慢，我们只能询问其一个简单的问题。
descriptions.en: We didn't detect life forms below the surface. We detected them in the entire world! The frozen planet is interspersed with micro-thin tubes linked like a rudimentary computer. While the structure is primitive, its gigantic scale means it can probably rival some of [Owner.Capital.GetName]'s supercomputers in output. Even now, the computer seems to be active - our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] can interface with it, but since it's so slow, we would only be able to ask it a single question.

label.zh: 你能够解开这些计算吗？

tooltips.zh: 使用这个星球辅助我们计算当前的天体物理困局。
tooltips.en: Use the world to assist in calculating our current astrophysics dilemmas.

label.en: Best to observe it from afar.

options.script:
name = anomaly.6900.e
from = { set_deposit = d_engineering_4 }

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]有了更加惊怖的发现。他们早前扫描到的山脉，实际上是某个巨型蛋的卵壳膜。我们也不知道究竟是什么巨兽诞下了这么一枚蛋，更不知道何等的怖兽会从中孵化出来。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have discovered something rather monstrous. The mountain range they scanned earlier was in actuality the outer membrane of a gigantic egg. It's uncertain what behemoth could lay such an egg and what horror would hatch from it.

options.script:
name = anomaly.6905.a
from = { set_deposit = d_society_4 }

descriptions.zh: [FromFromFrom.GetName]的内部有什么东西超出我们所料。我们并没有发现什么巨兽生命的幼体，取而代之的只是一团基因浆。整个行星的内部填满了基因物质和资源。全部这些物质最终会变成什么还不明晰，但是如果不打破砂锅问到底，我们的星系可能会更加安全。
descriptions.en: The insides of [FromFromFrom.GetName] were not what we expected. Instead of some infant titanic lifeform, we've simply uncovered genetic slop. The entire planet is filled with genetic material and resources. What all this material would have become is unclear, but our galaxy is probably safer, not knowing.

descriptions.zh: 尽管这个蛋同我们文明之前遭遇到的虚空孶孽很相似，但是它孕育了更加伟大的存在。
descriptions.en: While similar to the voidspawn our civilization encountered before, this egg would have created something much grander.

descriptions.zh:
§R“它活了！它又活过来了！同如此至伟的造物相比，我们不过是微不足道的凡尘；面对如此伟大之物，繁星帝国之间的鸡毛琐事又可称几——”§!

[Root.GetName]最后的传输信号在此中断，当我们发送探测器去扫描[FromFromFrom.GetName]残骸的时候，我们只看到了一个空壳。看上去这个生物对自己的解放者并没有多少感激之情。
descriptions.en:
§R"IT LIVES! IT LIVES AGAIN! We are nothing but insignificant specks compared to such a creature; what does the ephemeral squabbling between empires matter in the face of such great-"§!

The last transmission of the [Root.GetName] cuts off there, and when we use our probes to scan the remains of [FromFromFrom.GetName], we find a hollow shell. It seems the creature had little gratitude to show its liberators.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_gestalt = no } }

descriptions.zh: 我们派遣去往[Solar_System.GetName]星系的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]全部拉响了警报，但是没过多久就系数同[Owner.GetBrainName]失去了联系，只告诉了我们§R“它松动了。”§!当蛋壳开始裂开的时候，[Root.GetName]最后的传输信号被切断；当我们发射探测器去扫描[FromFromFrom.GetName]的残骸的时候，我们只看到了一个空壳。看上去这个生物对自己的解放者并没有多少感激之情。
descriptions.en: Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] dispatched to the [Solar_System.GetName] system all reacted in alarm shortly before losing contact with the [Owner.GetBrainName], only telling us that §R"It's loose."§! The last transmission of the [Root.GetName] cuts off as the egg begins to crack open, and when we use our probes to scan the remains of [FromFromFrom.GetName], we find a hollow shell. It seems the creature had little gratitude for its liberator.
descriptions.condition: trigger = { owner = { is_gestalt = yes } }

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]上发现的这座巨大的碑塔让我们的科研船派过去都微如蝼蚁。在这块宏伟的、光滑的板状金属表面，曾经炫目的彩色图案如今已变得斑驳。

机器的侧面一处小的能量出口似乎暗示着只要以适量的能量币作为交换，它的秘密就能悉数揭示，
descriptions.en:
The monolith we found on [From.GetName] dwarfs the science ship we sent to investigate it. A majestic, smooth slab of metal, the once-garish pigment patterns on the front have been reduced to mere flecks.

A small power outlet on the machine's side promises its secrets will be unveiled in exchange for a modest sum of energy credits.

options.script: name = "anomaly.7000.b"

descriptions.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

圆柱状罐体中保存着某种远古的饮料，奇迹般地抵御了时间的侵蚀。依据市场数据，这种失传已久的饮品比我们目前能为生物体提供的最好的饮料还要好喝20%。
descriptions.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains an ancient beverage, still miraculously preserved against the ravages of time. According to our market data, the long-forgotten drink is 20% more delicious than our current range of drinkable products for biological entities.

descriptions.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

 圆柱状罐体中保存着某种远古的饮料，奇迹般地抵御了时间的侵蚀。尽管这种饮品对我们没有直接用处，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]已可以把它们转化成更有用的资源：§Y异星天然气§!。
descriptions.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains an ancient beverage, still miraculously preserved against the ravages of time. While the liquid provides no substance to us, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have been able to convert it into a much more valuable resource: §YExotic Gas§!.

descriptions.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

圆柱状罐体中保存着某种远古的饮料，奇迹般地抵御了时间的侵蚀。这种饮品已经轻易地被我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]复制出来了，经过了大量缜密的测试后确认，这种液体干净又卫生，富有营养，而且关键的是还很好喝。
descriptions.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains an ancient beverage, still miraculously preserved against the ravages of time. The drink has been easily replicated by our [Owner.GetScientistPlural], who, after conducting rigorous testing, have ascertained it to be safe, nutritious and - most crucially - delicious.

descriptions.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

这个圆柱状罐体内部是中空的，其内容物早就已经从腐蚀掉的封盖中蒸发殆尽。这个罐体自身状态良好，构成其的未知合金与我们用于建造舰船的合金水平相当。
descriptions.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder is empty, its content long evaporated through a corroded sealing cap. The container itself is still in good shape, though, and the unknown alloy is on par with the metal we use to make our ships.

descriptions.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

圆柱状罐体内部包含的液体混合物含有蔗糖、柠檬酸和其他生物性物质。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信它是一种由碳基生命制造并饮用的富有营养的物质。进一步的研究有可能能提供关于这种已消亡物种的生物学线索。
descriptions.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains a liquid mixture of sucrose, citric acid, and other biological compounds. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe it to be a nutrient substance made by and for carbon-based beings. Further studies will hopefully provide more clues pertaining to the biology of this lost race.

descriptions.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

其中包含的液体恶臭不堪；这种曾经可口的营养物质被岁月的流逝所腐坏。通过研究这些物质，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]期望可以获悉一些关于曾经喜爱这种饮品的外星人的生物学信息，假定我们能先搞定它的臭味的话。
descriptions.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains a liquid most foul; a once-delicious nutrient long spoiled by time. By studying the substance, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] hope to learn about the biology of the aliens who once delighted in it - assuming we can do something about the smell first.

label.zh: 给罐里头的饮料注册专利，然后把它卖给全星系。
label.en: Patent the drink. Sell it to the whole galaxy.

descriptions.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船。它使用的推进方式与现代舰船并不相同，而是依赖于在真空中展开的巨大的帆来进行。也许这艘船可以捕获恒星能量，并在星光和恒星风的推动下前进。
descriptions.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship of unusual design. Instead of using propulsion similar to that of modern ships, the craft relied on large sails unfurled in the vacuum of space. Presumably, the ship harvested solar energy and drifted on the solar winds created by starlight.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。这艘科研船的外壳搭载了一个扩增的探测阵列，没有配备武器。船体外部在撞击之前没有受到任何伤害。我们可以假设，这场灾难之所以发生，是因为船员酿成的某种致命错误。
descriptions.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship half-buried in an asteroid crater. This science ship's exterior has an extensive sensory array and no weaponry. The exterior was not damaged in any way before it crashed. We can assume this catastrophe was the result of a fatal error caused by the crew.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]一开始以为这是小行星，结果发现这其实是冰冻的、被压实的缇扬奇尸体，在轨道上历经几十年之后，成为一堆不成形状的块状物。整个小行星环，实际上，是一片露天墓地。其中的一部分尸体是最近刚刚到达并开始腐坏的，而剩下的已历经千年岁月，甚至比我们的帝国还要久远。
descriptions.en: What our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] first mistook for asteroids have been revealed to be frozen, battered Tiyanki corpses reduced to shapeless lumps after decades in orbit. The entire asteroid ring is, in fact, just an open burial ground. Some of the bodies we acquired are recently deceased, while others predate our empire by thousand of years.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]一开始以为这是小行星，结果发现这其实是冰冻的、被压实的外星动物尸体，其体型基本和在这个恒星系游荡的外星生命体一致。整个小行星环，实际上，是一片露天墓地。其中的一部分尸体是最近刚刚到达并开始腐坏的，而剩下的已历经千年岁月，甚至比我们的帝国还要久远。
descriptions.en: What our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] first mistook for asteroids have been revealed to be frozen, battered corpses of alien fauna, roughly matching the shape of the aliens seen roaming the system. The entire asteroid ring is, in fact, just an open burial ground. Some of the bodies we acquired are recently deceased, while others predate our empire by thousand of years.

descriptions.zh:
我们起先认为这是一种刻意的交流尝试，结果发现它不过是一种不常见的自然现象。这颗行星产生的磁力波只要进行合适的调整和编辑，就可以听起来像歌唱一般，但这肯定不是由任何有意识的个体产生的。然而我们的一些科学家也发现，这“歌声”相当地吸引人。

也许我们可以利用这一现象，比如招待艺术家或VIP到空间站中，然后捕获这些信号，把它们作为一种放松的音乐播放给他们听。
descriptions.en:
What we first assumed to be a deliberate attempt at communication has turned out to be an unusual but naturally occurring phenomenon. The magnetic waves produced by the planet, given proper handling and editing, may sound a bit like talking or even singing, but they are in no way created by a thinking being. Some of our scientists, however, find it quite catchy.

It might be possible to make use of this phenomenon, possibly by hosting artists or VIPs at a station created solely to catch these signals and play them as relaxing music.

descriptions.zh: 这颗行星发射出了一系列信号，我们的探索无人机认为它们应该是人造的。但在进一步的检测后，我们发现这些信号不过是一些自然发生的不寻常但无害的磁力波。这一发现并没有产生即时有效的收益，但由于实在是太特别，在长期的研究中它可以提供一些研究数据。
descriptions.en: The planet is emitting a series of signals that our exploratory drones speculated might be of artificial origin. Upon closer examination, the signals were revealed to be merely a natural phenomenon caused by unusual but harmless magnetic waves. This discovery does not provide any immediate benefit to the collective, but given their uniqueness, studying them may provide us with some research data in the long run.

descriptions.zh: 这颗行星发射出了一系列信号，我们的探索工蜂认为它们应该是人造的。但在进一步的检测后，我们发现这些信号不过是一些自然现象，它的独特性质可以用于增强我们的工蜂与主脑的连接。用这颗行星产生的磁力波照射工蜂后它们可以更好地响应主脑的意志。
descriptions.en: The planet is emitting a series of signals that our exploratory drones speculated might be of artificial origin. Upon closer examination, they turned out to be nothing more than a natural phenomenon, one with the unusual property of strengthening the connection of our drones to the collective mind. It seems that drones exposed to the planet's magnetic waves respond better to the will of the hive.

tooltips.zh: 蜂巢可以复制这些磁力波，用于增强自己的意志。
tooltips.en: The hive can replicate these magnetic waves and use them to strengthen its will.

descriptions.zh: 在探察冰面下方之后我们得出结论，这处位于[From.GetName]的异常热信号是由热液泉引起的。类似的地方这个星球上似乎还有更多，但是我们尚未发现。
descriptions.en: After probing beneath the surface, we have concluded the unusual heat signatures on [From.GetName] are caused by hydrothermal springs. There seems to be more to this planet than meets the eye...

label.zh: 真是棒极了。但我们没必要继续在这上面耗费精力了。
label.en: Remarkable. But we need not waste any more resources on this.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]的船员的进一步探索揭示出热水来源的行星地壳深处竟然密布着微观生命体！我们一度以为空无一物的冰封星球事实上孕育着一个欣欣向荣的水下生物圈。
descriptions.en: Continued exploration by the crew of [From.GetName] has revealed the hot water coming from deep within the planet's crust is teeming with microscopic life! What we once thought of as an empty, frozen planet, actually contains a thriving underwater biosphere!

descriptions.zh:
[From.GetName]的异常能量读数的来源确定是一个蓝色的小球。[Owner.GetScientistPlural]汇报，传感器从中发现了相反极性的快子。

该物体周围的地面上刻着符号，也许是由某个更古老的文明留下的。目前不清楚是符号的含义是指引还是警示。

完整的文本还远不能翻译，但部分符号似乎与时间测量和[Solar_System.GetName]恒星系中天体相对位置有关。
descriptions.en:
The source of the unusual energy readings noted on [From.GetName] is confirmed to be a small, blue orb. The [Owner.GetScientistPlural] report that sensors pick up tachyons of reverse polarity.

Symbols are carved into the ground around the object, perhaps placed there by an older civilization. It is unclear whether they are meant as an instruction, or a warning.

The full inscription is far from translated, but individual symbols seem related to the measuring of time and the relative positions of celestial objects in the [Solar_System.GetName] system.

descriptions.zh:
在[FromFrom.GetName]发现的蓝色能量球体消失了。对当地的扫描完全没有发现该球体的任何迹象。更令人困惑的是，地上的符号也一同消失得无影无踪，如同从未存在过一般。

基于在此处发现的异常的快子信号，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]推断，球体和符号一同发生了时间回溯。
descriptions.en:
The orb of blue energy first detected on [FromFrom.GetName] has disappeared. A scan of the location show no traces of the strange sphere. Even more baffling is the erasure of the markings on the ground: it is as if they were never there.

Given the unusual tachyon readings we detected at the site, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] postulate that both the orb and the writing were moving backwards through time.

descriptions.zh:
在[FromFrom.GetName]上的站点进行工作时，[Root.GetLeaderName]无意间擦到了蓝色球体。

[leader.GetHeSheCap]之后称看到了时间如同一条河流一般延展，前后连接着无尽的过去与未来。在[leader.GetHimHer]的面前，蓝色能量从时间流中蜿蜒涌出，被吸入了[leader.GetHisHer]的身体里。尽管该意外在[Owner.GetScientistPlural]精确测量中持续了不到一秒钟，但[leader.GetHeShe]感觉仿佛度过了一个多小时。

在幻觉结束后，[Root.GetLeaderName]确信时间不会再影响[leader.GetHimHer]了。[leader.GetHeShe]现在拥有了无限的时间，于是想利用无尽的寿命自行探索宇宙。
descriptions.en:
While working at the site on [FromFrom.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] brushed against the blue orb.

[leader.GetHeSheCap] later described a vision of time stretching out like a river into the infinite future and past. In front of [leader.GetHimHer], blue energy arced out of the timestream and was absorbed by [leader.GetHisHer] body. Although the incident was accurately measured by the other [Owner.GetScientistPlural] to span less than a second, [leader.GetHeShe] experienced it for more than a hour.

After the vision ended, [Root.GetLeaderName] was certain that time would no longer affect [leader.GetHimHer]. With an infinite lifetime ahead, [leader.GetHeShe] want[leader.GetSXX] to use [leader.GetHisHer] endless time to explore the universe on [leader.GetHisHer] own.

descriptions.zh:
长程扫描发现了一艘舰船正在驶向[Root.Capital.GetName]。随着它越来越近，我们发现那艘船的设计与我们一世纪前的如出一辙。

在打开通讯之后，我们发现那艘舰船是[intemporal_explorer.GetName]驾驶的，就是那位被蓝色球体从时间流中带走的[Owner.GetScientist]。

[intemporal_explorer.GetHeSheCap]在对撞的中子星和逆转的时空引力井周围漫步，又乘坐飞船返回虚空。值得一提的是，我们的物理学家证实，他带回来的信息不仅大部分是可信的，而且甚至是开创性的。

[intemporal_explorer.GetName]的身体似乎完全不随着时间的流逝而改变，即便我们最近的科技也无法解释那颗球体的功能。[intemporal_explorer.GetHeShe]得以逃脱终极灭亡，将会继续探索宇宙，直到时间的终结。
descriptions.en:
Long-range scans picked up an approaching vessel near [Root.Capital.GetName]. As it moved closer, it became clear that the ship's design matched our own from a century ago.

After opening comms, we discovered that the ship was piloted by [intemporal_explorer.GetName], the [Owner.GetScientist] who [intemporal_explorer.GetWasWere] detached from the timestream by a blue energy orb.

[intemporal_explorer.GetHeSheCap] rambled about colliding neutron stars and inverse space-time gravitational wells, before taking the ship back into the dark. Remarkably, our physicists have confirmed that much of this information is not only verifiable, but indeed groundbreaking.

[intemporal_explorer.GetName] appeared physically unchanged by the passage of time, but even our current technology could not explain the functionality of the orb. Barring their own fatal destruction, [intemporal_explorer.GetHeShe] will continue to explore the universe until the end of time.

在[From.GetName]上正要着手开展钻取作业之后，[Root.GetLeaderName]产生了强烈的幻觉。虽然没有受到身体伤害，但他们报告说，他们起先是被破碎不连贯的视觉和嗅觉幻觉所淹没，这些幻觉展现了某种未知的外星物种。

已经准备了一项特殊项目来进一步调查这些怪异的晶体贮藏。
descriptions.en:
After setting up to drill into the ice layer on [From.GetName], [Root.GetLeaderName] experienced intense sensations. While not physically harmed, they reported being initially overwhelmed by disjointed visual and olfactory hallucinations depicting an unknown alien species.

A special project has been prepared to investigate this strange crystal deposit further.

descriptions.zh:
在冰面以下，晶体自身几乎构成了行星的大部分物质。取样分析表明有一处用于数据存储的人工高密度晶格。估测表明这些存储的数据远比我们所有的集体数据库都要庞大。

似乎这个晶体的建造者使用灵能共振来写入数据。[Root.GetLeaderName]非常好奇，并申请在表面建造一座自动研究站。
descriptions.en:
Below the ice, the crystal itself makes up the majority of the planet's mass. Samples suggest an artificially dense lattice is used for data storage. Estimates indicate the volume of stored knowledge is magnitudes beyond everything in our collective database.

It is likely that the builders of this crystal used a psionic resonance to imprint data. [Root.GetLeaderName] is so intrigued, that they have requested permission to oversee the creation of an automated research station on the surface

label.en: Studying it from orbit will do.

tooltips.zh: [FromFromFrom.GetName]上将新增一处小型研究矿藏。
tooltips.en: A small research deposit will be added to [FromFromFrom.GetName].

tooltips.zh: [FromFromFrom.GetName]上将新增一处大型研究矿藏，但可能对[Root.GetLeaderName]存在危险。
tooltips.en: A large research deposit will be added to [FromFromFrom.GetName], but it could be dangerous for [Root.GetLeaderName].

tooltips.zh: [FromFromFrom.GetName]上将新增一处稀有水晶矿藏。在获得了相应的科技后就可以进行开采。
tooltips.en: A rare crystal deposit will be added to [FromFromFrom.GetName]. We will be able to mine it if we have the appropriate technology.

descriptions.zh:
在自动研究站即将竣工时，晶体突然释放出了一阵极强的能量活动，[Root.GetLeaderName]不幸当场毙命。不一会儿之后，我们收到了一份自称来自[leader.GetHimHer]的自动通讯。

尽管其身体的神经系统已经无法修复，但其意识被困在了水晶中。由于身处[leader.GetHisHer]这种新的境地，[leader.GetSheHe]可以帮助我们深入晶体数据库在未来进行进一步的研究。
descriptions.en:
Nearing the completion of the automated research station, there was a sudden spike in activity from the crystal which left [Root.GetLeaderName] dead. Soon after, we received an autonomous communique claiming to be from [leader.GetHimHer].

While their body's nervous system is beyond repair, their mind has been trapped within the crystal. Making the best of [leader.GetHisHer] new situation, [leader.GetSheHe] has offered to assist with any future research into the crystal database.

descriptions.zh:
我们在[desertling_planet.GetName]上发现了生命。没有智慧的小型哺乳动物群遍布在整个行星表面。

我们的科学家将它们标记为“沙生兽”，它们的数量正以惊人的速度增加。这个行星已经超出了它的承载能力，生态系统正在迅速恶化。
descriptions.en:
We have found life on [desertling_planet.GetName]. Vast non-sapient herds of small mammals roam across the entire planetary surface.

Their population, labeled 'desertlings' by our scientists, is increasing at an alarming rate. The planet is already beyond its capacity, and the ecosystem is deteriorating rapidly.

label.zh: 调查为什么现在会发生这种情况。
label.en: Investigate why this is happening now.

tooltips.zh: 我们将从远处监控局势。
tooltips.en: We'll monitor the situation from afar.

descriptions.zh:
在研究[desertling_planet.GetName]上的沙生兽时，我们的科学家观察到了一个关键的现象。尽管这个物种到处都是，但却没有相应的化石记录。这些生态入侵者在相对短的时间内造成了极端的环境破坏，很可能是被某个外来者带到这里的。

形势已经十分清楚，迫切需要我们进行干预。如果不采取行动，这些生物将摧毁这个星球自然生态系统中剩下的一切。
descriptions.en:
While studying the desertlings on [desertling_planet.GetName] our scientists have made a pivotal observation. Despite the ubiquitous nature of the species, there is a striking absence of matching fossil records. These ecological interlopers have caused extreme environmental damage over a relatively short time period, and were most likely transported here by an outside actor.

The pressing need for intervention has become abundantly clear. Without action, these creatures will destroy what remains of this planet's natural ecosystem.

label.zh: 我们将尽可能多收养这些小东西。
label.en: We will adopt as many critters as possible.

tooltips.zh: 我们将对他们的行为负责。
tooltips.en: We will be responsible for their actions.

label.zh: 制定动物数量控制政策。

tooltips.zh: 选择遗传修饰可用于遏制生长…
tooltips.en: Select genetic modifications could be used to curb the growth...

tooltips.zh: 必须不惜一切代价保护行星。
tooltips.en: The planet must be protected at all cost.

label.zh: 我们将一些动物当作牲口。
label.en: We'll take some animals as livestock.

tooltips.zh: 我们将向每个殖民地带去两个奴隶。
tooltips.en: We'll take two slaves for every colony.

descriptions.zh:
我们收到消息，[desertling_planet.GetName]已经屈服于指数繁殖的哺乳动物的侵袭。深深的寂静笼罩着现在贫瘠的大地，所有存留的植被都被吞噬到根部。

杂食性的哺乳动物奄奄一息，要么直接饿死，要么在愈演愈烈的饥荒中被同类吃掉。
descriptions.en:
We have received news that [desertling_planet.GetName], has succumbed to the infestation of the exponentially breeding mammals. Deep silence envelops the now barren landscape, where all traces of vegetation have been devoured down to their roots.

The omnivorous mammals themselves lie still, either perished from starvation, or eaten by their kin as the famine progressed.
