descriptions.zh:
经过艰苦的努力，我们对[desertling_planet.GetName]上的沙漠生物进行扑杀和基因改造，它们的数量终于降低到了一个可持续的水平。

没有了过多的食草动物，一个微妙的平衡出现了。大自然正在迅速恢复，新鲜的草地开始在曾经荒凉的沙漠上生长。
descriptions.en:
After an arduous effort to sterilize and genetically alter the desertlings on [desertling_planet.GetName], their population has finally been reduced to a sustainable level.

Without the overwhelming amount of grazers, a delicate equilibrium has emerged. Nature is rapidly restoring itself, as fresh patches of grass begin to sprout over the once barren desert.

descriptions.zh: 最终，最后一只啮齿动物在[desertling_planet.GetName]上死去。沙子本身已经被染成了红色，这是因为我们为拯救星球免于侵染所付出的巨大努力，但是新的绿芽已经开始萌发。我们出手的时候刚刚好。
descriptions.en: Finally, the last of the rodents lie dead on [desertling_planet.GetName]. The sand itself has been tinted red by our massive effort to save the planet from its infestation, but already new green buds have begun to sprout. We were just in time.

descriptions.zh:
瑟顿之中的景象光怪陆离。涡旋的行星在黑暗中若隐若现；附近是我们宇宙本身织构的一个缺口，也是一个吞噬着其中恒星光芒的宇宙巨胃。

尽管行星体的排列看似正常，但进一步的研究发现它们是以一种非常精确的数学关系安排到一起的。数百万年前，某种难以置信的力量将这个恒星系的轨道天体编排成了一种独特的图样，这种图案不仅影响着裂隙，还避免了它裂向更广阔的星系。

我们似乎来得正好——这项史诗级的工程即将竣工。这个星系距离恢复正常近在咫尺。
descriptions.en:
Seddom is an eerie spectacle. The swirling planets are wreathed in darkness; nearby is a breach in the very fabric of our universe, a cosmic maw that devours the very radiance of the system's star.

Despite the seemingly natural arrangement of planetoids, further analysis has revealed that they are arranged with mathematical precision. Millennia ago, some incredible force orchestrated the orbital bodies of this system into a specialized pattern, one which has not only mitigated the effects of the tear, but prevented it from spreading into the wider galaxy.

We arrive here at an auspicious moment - a monumental work nears completion. This system's restoration is imminent.

label.zh: 谢谢你修复我们的星系。
label.en: Thank you for fixing our galaxy.

descriptions.zh: [from.Solar_System.GetName]恒星系的重力稳定是由小行星带中释放出来的§Y暗物质§!维系起来的。这些发射源被一台位于中心行星上的超级电脑控制着。中控电脑的记录表明，整个恒星系是一处由某个远古文明建设的重力操控实验设施。
descriptions.en: The gravitational stability of the [from.Solar_System.GetName] system is maintained by §YDark Matter§! emitters positioned within its asteroid belt. These emitters are controlled by a supercomputer located on the central planet. Records from this central computer suggest the entire system was an experimental site for gravity manipulation, established by an ancient civilization.

tooltips.en: Adds §Y£physics£ +1§! and §Y£sr_dark_matter£ §Y+1§!§! to every §YGravity Manipulator Asteroid§!

descriptions.zh:
对[From.GetName]的进一步探索非但没解开多少谜题，反而让它更加疑点重重。这里的地表到处都散落着栩栩如生的雕塑，脸上无声地凝固着痛苦的神情。

科学家们的意见发生了分歧；有些认为这些东西曾经是生物，是被一种未知的力量变成了石头。而另一些则认为它们代表了一个失落已久的文明所崇拜的神灵。更谨慎的少数人认为，这些雕像不是一种致敬，而是一种警告：对任何胆敢骚扰这颗行星的人发出严厉的警告。
descriptions.en:
Continued exploration of [From.GetName] has yielded more questions than answers. The surface is littered with eerily lifelike statues, their expressions petrified in silent agony.

Our scientists are divided; some believe that these forms were once living beings, turned to stone by an unknown force. Others suggest they represent deities, worshipped by a long-forgotten civilization. A more cautious few believe the statues are not a tribute, but a warning: a grim message to any who would dare to disturb the planet.

descriptions.zh:
对[From.GetName]的进一步探索非但没解开多少谜题，反而让它更加疑点重重。这里的地表到处都散落着栩栩如生的雕塑，脸上无声地凝固着痛苦的神情。

我们的集体意识中涌出了许多关于这些雕像的不同想法，比如它们可能是被未知力量变成石头的活物，或者代表了某种古代失落文明所崇拜的神祇。亦或许这些雕像并不是致敬，而是一种警告：对任何胆敢骚扰这颗行星的人发出严厉的警告。
descriptions.en:
Continued exploration of [From.GetName] has yielded more questions than answers. The surface is littered with eerily lifelike statues, their expressions petrified in silent agony.

Many different thoughts flood our collective consciousness some of these forms could have been living beings, turned to stone by an unknown force. Or perhaps they represent deities, worshipped by a long-forgotten civilization. Maybe these statues are not a tribute, but a warning: a grim message to any who would dare to disturb the planet.

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]船员的进一步调查发现，这些雕像是某种与石质类高度相似的古代物种的遗骸。曾经维持其形态的某种力量早已消散了。现在，它们暴露在自然环境中，被逐渐侵蚀成细小的灰尘，将它们的历史残余散进了[From.GetName]无情的风中。
descriptions.en: Further investigation by the crew of [From.GetName] has identified the statues as remnants of an ancient species bearing strong resemblance to the Lithoids. Whatever essence once held their forms together has long since deteriorated. Now, exposed to the elements, they gradually erode into fine dust scattering the remains of its history into the relentless winds of [From.GetName].

descriptions.zh: [From.GetName]号船员们的进一步尝试被一阵突如其来的狂风打断，这股风横扫了整个研究现场。那些脆弱的石像瞬间化为齑粉，它们曾承载的谜题也随之湮灭无痕。由于缺乏可供分析的残留证据，也无法得出明确结论，我们别无选择，只能终止此次调查。
descriptions.en: Further attempts by the crew of [From.GetName] were abruptly halted when a sudden gust of wind swept across the research site. The brittle stone figures crumbled into dust, erasing any trace of the riddle they once posed. With no remaining evidence to analyze and no clear conclusions to be drawn, we are left with little choice but to discontinue the investigation.

descriptions.zh: 在[From.GetName]冰壳之下的勘探，我们发现了一片广阔的地下洞穴。令人惊叹的是，这座隐蔽的温室中存在着一个郁郁葱葱的生态系统——茂密的动植物在隔绝环境中蓬勃生长，受到冰层保护而远离星球表面恶劣的环境。洞穴内保持着稳定的微气候，很可能是由地热喷口维持的。
descriptions.en: Excavation beneath the icy crust of [From.GetName] has revealed a vast subterranean cavern. Remarkably, this hidden greenhouses is a thriving ecosystem, a lush flora and fauna flourish in isolation, protected by the ice from the planet's surface otherwise hostile environment. The cave maintains a stable microclimate, likely sustained by geothermal vents.

label.en: There is more to explore here.

descriptions.zh:
在洞穴的更深处，我们遇到了一片广袤的花田。当主动观测开始时，整片花田瞬间绽放，整个洞窟被绚丽的生物荧光所淹没。植物学分析表明，该物种每一亿年才开花一次，需要环境因素达到精确的排列组合才能触发。

我们的到来竟与如此罕见的事件同时发生，这概率微乎其微。但无论纯属巧合还是另有玄机，这无疑是一次非凡的体验。
descriptions.en:
Deeper within the cavern, we encountered a sprawling field of flowers. The moment active observation began, the entire field erupted into bloom, flooding the chamber in radiant bioluminescence. Botanical analysis suggests this species only blooms once every 100 million years, triggered by a precise alignment of environmental factors.

That our arrival coincided with such an event defies all probability, but whether mere coincidence or something more, it was surely a remarkable experience.

descriptions.zh: 随着进一步深入洞穴，地震活动突然导致结构失稳。突如其来的构造震颤在岩壁间传导，随时可能引发坍塌。面对迅速恶化的环境，我们立即启动了紧急撤离程序。洞穴中的秘密只能徒留遗憾，无法探索了。
descriptions.en: Upon further descent into the cavern, seismic activity abruptly destabilized the structure. A sudden tectonic tremor cascaded through the walls, threatening to trigger an imminent collapse. Faced with the rapidly deteriorating conditions, we initiated immediate evacuation protocols. The secrets within the cave remain unexplorable.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的调查目前取得了一些有趣的成果，这颗小行星的中心是一个完美的球形空腔，光滑的墙壁似乎是由原子级别的精度雕琢而成。空腔的中央悬浮着一艘小型舰船，它似乎在向[Root.GetName]发出问候，并且也只和[Root.GetLeaderName]对话。
descriptions.en: Our study of [From.GetName] has yielded interesting results. Within the core of the asteroid is the negative space of a perfect sphere. The walls are so smooth as to have been carved with atomic precision, and hovering in the center is a small vessel. It appears to be hailing [Root.GetName] and will only speak to [Root.GetLeaderName].

label.en: Put that on the main viewer.

descriptions.zh:
经统计学计算，你已经荒废了自身63%的潜能。
在接下来的47秒内向我证明你存在的价值，不然的话我就将你从因果中移除。
descriptions.en:
You have squandered 63% of your statistically allotted potential.
Justify your existence in the next 47 seconds... or be excised from causality.

label.en: Who are you? What do you want?

label.en: Who are you to judge? What gives you the right?!

descriptions.zh: 我们在[From.GetName]的研究目前取得了一些有趣的成果。这颗小行星的核心含有放射性物质，在其衰变过程中会发出周期性脉冲。虽然科学家[Root.GetLeaderName]可能永远无法从大剂量的伽马辐射中恢复过来了，但这种脉冲是可以预测的，之后的研究人员不会受到伤害。
descriptions.en: Our study of [From.GetName] has yielded interesting results. The asteroid possesses a core of radioactive material that emits a periodic pulse as it deteriorates. While our scientist, [Root.GetLeaderName], may never recover from the large dose of gamma radiation, the pulsing is predictable and poses no risk to future researchers.
